description: For any ToolCallRecord within a trace, classify_tool_call returns exactly one of Useful or Redundant; the sum of useful + redundant classifications equals the total number of records

preconditions.description: A trace of tool call records is submitted for classification

expectedOutcome.description: Every record receives exactly one classification (mutual exclusivity) and no records are left unclassified (exhaustiveness)

verificationMethod.testName: Property 5: Classification mutual exclusivity and exhaustiveness
